critical_code_review_comments: SeoLanding.jsx correctly composes BreadcrumbList + SoftwareApplication + FAQPage JSON-LD only when faq present — verified in DOM for all 13 SEO pages.
ComparePage.jsx correctly applies noindex=(!page||!page.verified) — all 4 competitor pages render 'noindex, follow' as required. Unknown slug renders Navigate to '/' (SPA client redirect) — works.

SeoLanding.jsx renders TWO possibly-clashing footer-link-* testids for e.g. /about because SEO_FOOTER_LINKS and COMPANY_FOOTER_LINKS share the same testid prefix pattern; not currently a collision since SEO_FOOTER_LINKS doesn't include /about,/contact,/security. Safe as-is but fragile — consider a distinct prefix like footer-company-link-* to prevent future duplicate testids.
CompanyPages.jsx About/Contact/Security have NO SoftwareApplication or FAQPage JSON-LD — only BreadcrumbList. That matches the review spec ('BreadcrumbList JSON-LD valid'), so PASS.
Security page correctly avoids compliance-certification claims; only cites PCI-DSS *via Stripe* as a factual statement about the payment processor. Good.
